sources.title: TIGER/Line Shapefiles 2018 — County and Equivalent
sources.license: U.S. federal Census geographic data; public-domain use.
sources.source_crs: NAD83 geographic coordinates (EPSG:4269), as declared by tl_2018_us_county.prj.
sources.selection: All 16 issue GEOIDs; source attributes and geometry retained in a deterministic GeoJSON subset.
sources.restoration: Download the canonical full archive; verify the archive byte count/SHA above; extract tl_2018_us_county.shp/.shx/.dbf; filter exactly the 16 issue GEOIDs; retain the NAD83 CRS declaration; compare selected feature roster and geometry.
sources.role: Official source-vintage check, particularly Alameda–San Francisco; not a legal determination of county water boundaries.
sources.extraction_method: Selected all 16 GEOID values from the archive shapefile with pyshp 2.3.1; preserved source properties and NAD83 coordinates; canonical JSON used sort_keys=true, separators=comma-colon, UTF-8 and one final LF, gzip level 9 with mtime=0.
